findings.description: The `finally` clause always runs after the except block and sets `job.next_run = now + job.interval`. This overwrites the `now + self._retry_delay(job)` set at line 65 on failure. Failed jobs are therefore never retried sooner, so the new retry_delay/backoff feature has no effect.
findings.suggestion: Set `job.next_run = now + job.interval` only in the `else` branch, or remove the `finally` and keep the assignment in each branch.
